# Vendored build base

Dinghy GPL-3.0 source snapshot copied from the local M-vave Dinghy checkout on
2026-11-26: firmware/, tools/, tests/, build.sh and LICENSE only. Original Git HEAD
was ea1b6bf5973b11f9b4b806d08155602aaa0b505e. The source checkout had local sequencer
edits; this is a filesystem snapshot, not a claim of a pristine upstream commit.
The experiment overlay replaces dinghy.c during staging. No source checkout,
.git directory, other product firmware or credentials are shared at runtime.

Keep copyright and license notices. The previous releases each retain their own
exact staged source archive and package hashes. New builds use this local base.
SDK and compiler files remain local ignored build prerequisites; their existing
licenses and notices were retained with their copied files.
